newsitem.title: USA: M.S. Carriers sees Q4 shr below forecasts.
newsitem.headline: M.S. Carriers sees Q4 shr below forecasts.

text.p: M.S. Carriers Inc, a truckload carrier, said late Tuesday that it expected to report fourth-quarter earnings of between $0.16 per share and $0.19 per share, which would fall short of analysts' estimates.
The company, which issued a statement after the Nasdaq market closed, said poor claims experience, higher fuel costs and an increase in empty miles were the reasons behind the shortfall.
Analysts had projected earnings of $0.33 per share for the quarter.
M.S. Carriers, which transports a wide range of general commodities in the United States, reported earnings of $0.22 per share for the fourth quarter last year.
